_comment: 1.5.5's export settings refusals, verbatim from the 1.5.5 binary (DATA: the test that reads it,
export_settings_refusal_1_5_5.rs, names no sink). module: the sink a case configures (a build that does not
serve it has no refusal of it to render); export: the `export:` block; line: 1.5.5's line; match: `exact` or
`prefix` (a sentence 1.5.5 printed unprefixed); once: the line is printed exactly once.

cases.export: metrics: { module: prometheus, settings: { buffer_seconds: 60, bogus: 1 } }
trace: { module: otlp, settings: { url: "http://127.0.0.1:4318/v1/traces", bogus: 1 } }

cases.line: export.file.settings: invalid type: integer `7`, expected a string
the `module: prometheus` export instance sets settings.buffer_seconds: 0, which retains no observations

cases.export:
one: { module: prometheus, settings: { buffer_seconds: 60 } }
  two: { module: prometheus, settings: { buffer_seconds: 60 } }
cases.line: export.two: a second `module: prometheus` instance (already defined as 'one'). Prometheus serves the ONE well-known /metrics route, so a second instance could only be silently ignored — keep a single instance.
